topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the scope, target audience, and key learning objectives of the cancer biology lecture series.

topics.label: Biological Basis of Cancer and Experimental Tissue Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops from accumulating genetic and epigenetic defects that disrupt cellular differentiation and tissue architecture, alongside the models used to study these processes in vitro.

topics.label: Invasion, Metastasis, and Stepwise Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the pathological distinction between benign and malignant tumors through tissue invasion, metastatic spread, and the stepwise histological progression of lesions.

topics.label: Tumor Nomenclature and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic establishes the standard conventions and notable exceptions used to categorize and name tumors based on their cell lineage and malignant potential.

topics.label: Pathophysiological Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how physical obstruction, tissue destruction, and systemic metastatic burden lead to clinical illness and death in cancer patients.

topics.label: Comparative Tumor Incidence in Humans and Other Animals
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the epidemiological patterns of tumor frequency across human tissues and throughout diverse multicellular animal species.

topics.label: Clinical Cancer Detection and Screening Approaches
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical principles, effectiveness, and limitations of early cancer detection and screening programmes across different tumor types.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing for the lecture, summarizing the session and offering instructions for upcoming practicals.
